overview: This enum chooses the curve used when a movement speed or reaction speed changes over time.

None.simple: The ordinary easing choice, which eases gently into the end of the change.
None.technical: ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc sends None through its default arm to EEasingFunc::EaseOut. FGameFloatEaseInterpolator.Start receives that function together with the row start speed, end speed, interpolation time, and blend exponent. Row constructors use None, and most exported easing fields also store None.

EaseIn.simple: The change starts slowly and builds speed toward the end.
EaseIn.technical: ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc returns EEasingFunc::EaseIn. EffectMoveDataTable exports one EaseIn row, and homing rows also export EaseIn for rotation speed and movement speed. The converted function is passed to FGameFloatEaseInterpolator.Start with the row timing and blend exponent.

EaseOut.simple: The change starts quickly and settles gently near the end.
EaseOut.technical: ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc returns EEasingFunc::EaseOut. EffectMoveDataTable exports 32 EaseOut speed rows. The converted function is passed to FGameFloatEaseInterpolator.Start with the row timing and blend exponent.

EaseInOut.simple: The change starts slowly, speeds up in the middle, and settles gently at the end.
EaseInOut.technical: ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc returns EEasingFunc::EaseInOut. No exported easing field in the inspected movement, damage, effect, homing, or global tables stores EaseInOut, so this case is known from the converter alone.

Invalid.technical: ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc has no Invalid case, so the default arm returns EEasingFunc::EaseOut. No exported easing field stores Invalid, and the header declares no enumerator between EaseInOut and Invalid.

notes: None resolves to EEasingFunc::EaseOut, so the shipped rows that store None use an ease-out curve.
The converted value is shared by character movement, shikigami homing, effect movement, and hit-reaction speed interpolation.
The header declares no enumerator between EaseInOut and Invalid.
